bestFor: 3-6 UI screenshots of the same feature across surfaces (desktop / mobile / chat). The angled frames read as a showcase rather than a spec sheet.
notes: Frames take each image's true aspect ratio, so mixed portrait/landscape sets stay uncropped with no letterbox slabs. Narrow tiles stack above wide ones so a tall phone screenshot can't be buried.
_source: Validated on the Martian Games poll set (Discord embed + mobile Copilot + web), 2026-07-19.
